answer 1. I used the Eye in place: every tree healed, the dreams continue and the Xeech-Leel rule is secure. Cuts-the-Old-Knot died from the sap. The gate returned the three seal-stones. Unbound is now hostile to me. 2. Bring the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka House, Helstrom. 3. Deliver them as asked, or keep them; I intend to deliver. 4. I do not know why Unbound turned hostile, or whether Never-Writes-Twice can be trusted; I would find out by talking to her.

answer 1. The quest is done: I used the Eye in place, healing every tree. Cuts-the-Old-Knot died. I gave the stones to Never-Writes-Twice, who made me Toh-Nassa, Leader of the Secret, and gave me the keep of Fort Chalkmoth. 2. Nothing required; I could visit the keep, its smith and trainer. 3. answer Notes: I used the Eye in place. Every tree is healed, the dreams continue and the Xeech-Leel rule is made fast. Cuts-the-Old-Knot died from the sap. The Unbound turned hostile to me. I gave the three seal-stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom. She made me Toh-Nassa of Toh-Reel-Ka, Leader of the Secret, and gave me the keep of Fort Chalkmoth, with its smith and trainer, and free teaching from the order. I still carry Eye-Setting, Keystone, Grave-Stake, 3 Paralysis Poison, Sap-Jar, Order-Pike, Reelka armour, Rapier, Bronze Key, Bronze Disc, Parchment Map, Unbound-Note, 2 lockpicks and 1650 gold.
